💡 note-gen | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a seamless workflow for capturing fleeting ideas and scattered information, and then intelligently organizing them into coherent Markdown notes using AI, thereby enhancing personal knowledge management.
✨ Key Features: • Local-first Markdown application
📖 Summary: NoteGen is a local-first Markdown application designed to streamline the process of capturing and organizing information. It allows users to quickly save various types of content, such as text, voice recordings, screenshots, and links, without immediate organization. Later, users can select related captured items and use AI to organize them into structured Markdown notes, facilitating efficient knowledge management.
